title: Bedrock shafts along the causeway as industrial infrastructure

tellings.quote: So, in in my opinion, that's part of the industrial infrastructure of the Giza Plateau.

plain: Shafts cut into the bedrock along the Khafre causeway, the ancient stone road leading up to the second pyramid at Giza, were part of an industrial system running across the plateau. A researcher named Jeffrey Drum offers this to Michels as his own opinion, without naming a source. It belongs to his larger claim that the pyramids sat on top of a huge energy grid, which would make Giza a working machine, not just a set of tombs.
